mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdown and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 550 and RSAFS > 350000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, indicating manufacturing contraction, typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS > 100,000) indicates a healthy labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) decline below 550,000 units signals weakening residential demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced construction sector activity and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) and declining GDP growth (GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate investment and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 and GDPC1 < 1.0.
